<style>
  /* Native Home variants own opacity 0; Designer owns the 20px button glass.
     Fade glass directly so no translucent controls parent blocks its backdrop.
     Playback wrappers still own play/pause/loading visibility. */
  @keyframes tdb-home-chrome-enter {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to { opacity: 1; }
  }
  html[data-wf-page="677cf86df9952f978d94d8a9"] .navbar10_component > .is-nav-bar-frame {
    /* Keep the page entrance independent of deferred menu enhancement. */
    animation: tdb-home-chrome-enter 200ms ease-out 100ms 1 normal forwards !important;
  }
  html[data-wf-page="677cf86df9952f978d94d8a9"] [data-vimeo-hero-shell] .vimeo-controls-layer :is(
    .vimeo-player__btn,
    .vimeo-player__bg,
    .vimeo-player__loading-svg
  ) {
    /* Explicit entrance survives the shared playback animation reset. */
    animation: tdb-home-chrome-enter 200ms ease-out 100ms 1 normal forwards !important;
  }

  /* The poster settles at a real opacity:1 after its entrance.
     Backwards fill covers only the initial delay; playback then uses the
     existing Designer transition to opacity:0, without a second animation. */
  html[data-wf-page="677cf86df9952f978d94d8a9"] [data-vimeo-hero-shell] [data-vimeo-hero-init]:not([data-vimeo-started="true"]):not([data-placeholder-hidden="true"]) .vimeo-bg__placeholder {
    opacity: 1;
    animation: tdb-home-chrome-enter 200ms ease-out 100ms 1 normal backwards;
  }
</style>

<script data-tdb-home-snag-pins>
/* Home-only reliability release. Runs while parsing, before deferred loaders. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const release = '996e193a99b2f2f8a1ef43b80e064802ae0708b1';
  const registry = document.querySelector('script[data-tdb-asset-pins]');
  if (registry) {
    const pins = JSON.parse(registry.dataset.tdbAssetPins || '{}');
    ['tdb-drawer.js','tdb-logo-marquee.min.js','tdb-usp-drawer.js'].forEach(file => { pins[file] = release; });
    ['tdb-drawer.js','tdb-usp-drawer.js'].forEach(file => { pins[file] = '7e1cea4365e1b6ef686295b054bf8469578c3d83'; });
    /* Home USP: native HTML and scoped CSS on first open, no warm-up. */
    pins['tdb-usp-drawer.js'] = 'eb916ade51aae9fabfeb181e3399c674c0345da4';
    pins['tdb-announcement.js'] = 'bd1bde66f6624d7c653eb6e29afb3f3c6acfaeb7';
    pins['tdb-reviews.js'] = 'ed44546aa2463da53cf732072fc3fb4b6cd71689';
    /* Partner card HTML/CSS/CMS content: first activation only; no warm-up. */
    pins['tdb-logo-marquee.min.js'] = '864588fce893de34a5fb48e21e8656c113c8311d';
    pins['tdb-partner-card.js'] = '5c59038b7132e8a65cd337a751cbb5b41405dd56';
    pins['tdb-partner-card.css'] = '5c59038b7132e8a65cd337a751cbb5b41405dd56';
    registry.dataset.tdbAssetPins = JSON.stringify(pins);
  }
})();
</script>
